name: fitfour
description: A 4-day gym program PWA. Static site — this file exists only for the test runner.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration

comments.shipping: Nothing here is served. netlify.toml publishes '.' with an empty build command, so the deployed site stays plain HTML/CSS/JS with no dependencies.
comments.unit: Runs on Node's built-in test runner with zero packages installed.
comments.integration: Needs Playwright: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium. Skips itself with instructions when it isn't there.
comments.network: Integration specs that hit YouTube/SoundCloud are skipped when FITFOUR_SKIP_NETWORK=1.
